review: Independent static prepared repair protocol re-review
scope: Static correctness/protocol review against previous three blockers, including changed helper, wrapper, recording fixtures and recovery evidence. No Cargo, recording fixture, real protocol, process experiment or CI executed.

findings.title: Concurrent split-index rotation can produce a saved index with the wrong dependency backup
findings.static_trace: Hook::new first resolves the live --shared-index-path, performs further reads, then copies the live index to before.index and the previously resolved dependency to before.shared-index. Another ordinary Git writer can rotate the split index between resolving the dependency and copying the main index, while preserving its semantic tree/work content. The saved main index then references the newer shared-index hash, but the owned backup and recovery.txt describe the older dependency. The prepared hook can accept this pair: cmp(actual index,before.index) matches the newer bytes, and cmp(old shared path,before.shared-index) independently matches older bytes; neither verifies the dependency named by before.index. A later failure therefore retains incomplete/misidentified recovery evidence.
findings.required_fix: Make the saved index/dependency pair self-consistent before permitting user dispatch. Derive/validate the shared-index dependency from the saved before.index itself (with the correct repository context), or use a consistent snapshot/stability protocol that refuses on rotation. Record and compare the dependency actually referenced by that saved main index. Keep existing conservative retention on any uncertain launched operation.
findings.required_evidence: First add a recording/static snapshot-rotation case that supplies old shared path, newer main-index snapshot and distinct newer dependency; assert either coherent captured pair or refusal before user update-ref. Later root-authorized owned split-index fixture should rotate its dependency at this boundary and demonstrate complete recovery evidence after a refused/later-failed transaction.

previous_findings.evidence: Conservative Git>=2.50 parser; exact files/reftable and sha1/sha256 allowlists; same-backend/object-format scratch repository proves git hook run/stdin/private selection and the exact native current-HEAD/branch transaction. User dispatch requires capability acknowledgement; completion requires exact prepared/checkout/committed proofs.

previous_findings.status: STRUCTURALLY RESOLVED by interim scope restriction; runtime proof pending
previous_findings.evidence: Remote mutating repairs refuse at UI/fix entry/Hook constructor/local transport, before repair work is dispatched. No remote hook lifecycle remains. All launched local scratch and user requests set keep=true before launch; any error/missing acknowledgement retains the directory, without treating absent markers as completion proof.

Native symref-verify HEAD and direct branch update share one transaction; scratch proof uses the current branch case. Original prepared hook runs first, then exact HEAD target/OID, raw index/dependency, stat-cold work-content and affected-path checks precede checkout. HEAD/index/work checks repeat after checkout and after original committed hook; later failures retain evidence without rollback.

other_static_observations: Quoted shell interpolation covers branch/object/proof/path arguments; original stdin is copied and replayed with quoted --to-stdin and argv. Original hooksPath is restored for nested calls; the outer sole -c is removed before relay.
Metadata-only rewrites use the same guarded HEAD/ref path. Git version refusal occurs before any user-ref transaction, although prior rewrite object preparation can create unreachable objects.

All scratch/local commands route through Practice-first repository_command and captured profile with absolute second -C. Ambient Git directory/index/namespace overrides are removed; lazy fetch is disabled on the guarded transport.
No new PID discovery, signal controller, FIFO or manual HEAD.lock is introduced. Existing approved owned bounded runner is reused.
Recording tests remain unexecuted; manually calling a fake-Git wrapper cannot establish real backend locking or Windows support.
limits_and_next_gates: Remote automatic repair is explicitly INTERIM unavailable, not a completed feature acceptance claim.
Supported Git files/reftable current-HEAD protocol may safely refuse if backend rejects conflicting locks; no successful backend proof has yet run.

After snapshot-pair fix and static acceptance: root schedules recording-only rejection/ownership/uncertainty cases first, assesses results, then may separately authorize actual owned held-lock/concurrent edit/hook-veto/later-failure/old-Git fixtures.
UTF8 metadata paths, non-sparse/no-assume-unchanged restrictions, 64MiB snapshots and normal Git normalization/filter semantics are explicit limits. No native Windows claim.
Full feature/auth/journal/default-port tests, combined gates and final independent review remain separate. No CI or PR.
release_decision: Resolve REPAIR-PROTOCOL-4 before accepting the static protocol gate. No runtime protocol authorized by this review.
